063        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, CargoTransferHandlerAPI transferHandler, Object stackSource) {
064                boolean useGray = true;
065                if (getClass() == BaseSpecialItemPlugin.class || Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) {
066                        useGray = false;
067                }
068                createTooltip(tooltip, expanded, transferHandler, stackSource, useGray);
069        }
070        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, CargoTransferHandlerAPI transferHandler, Object stackSource, boolean useGray) {
071                float opad = 10f;
072                
073                if (!Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) {
074                        tooltip.addTitle(getName());
075                } else {
076                        tooltip.addSpacer(-opad);
077                }
078                
079                String design = getDesignType();
080                Misc.addDesignTypePara(tooltip, design, opad);
081                
082                if (Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) {
083                        tooltip.setParaSmallInsignia();
084                }
085                if (!spec.getDesc().isEmpty()) {
086                        Color c = Misc.getTextColor();
087                        if (useGray) c = Misc.getGrayColor();
088                        tooltip.addPara(spec.getDesc(), c, opad);
089                }
090                
091//              if (Misc.isExtended() && stack != null && stack.isBlueprintStack()) {
092//                      tooltip.addPara("Can be sold for substantially more credits on the black market.", opad);
093//              }
094                
095                if (getClass() == BaseSpecialItemPlugin.class) {
096                        addCostLabel(tooltip, opad, transferHandler, stackSource);
097                }
098        }

127        protected void addCostLabel(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, float pad, CargoTransferHandlerAPI transferHandler, Object stackSource) {
128                if (stack == null) return;
129                
130                if (Misc.isExtended() && stack != null && stack.isBlueprintStack()) {
131                        if (Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) {
132                                tooltip.setParaSmallInsignia();
133                        }
134                        tooltip.addPara("Can be sold for substantially more credits on the black market.", pad);
135                }
136                
137                //if (Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) return;
138                if (Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) {
139                        int cost = (int) stack.getBaseValuePerUnit();
140                        tooltip.setParaFontDefault();
141                        tooltip.addPara("Base value: %s", pad, Misc.getGrayColor(), Misc.getHighlightColor(), Misc.getDGSCredits(cost));
142                        return;
143                        //tooltip.setParaSmallInsignia();
144                }
145                
146                ItemCostLabelData data = getCostLabelData(stack, transferHandler, stackSource);
147                
148                LabelAPI label = tooltip.addPara(data.text, pad);
149                if (data.highlights != null) {
150                        label.setHighlight(data.highlights.getText());
151                        label.setHighlightColors(data.highlights.getColors());
152                }
153        }
154        
155        
156        public static class ItemCostLabelData {
157                public String text;
158                public Highlights highlights;
159        }
160        
161        protected ItemCostLabelData getCostLabelData(CargoStackAPI stack, CargoTransferHandlerAPI transferHandler, Object stackSource) {
162                String text = "";
163                String highlight = null;
164                Highlights highlights = null;
165                Color highlightColor = Misc.getHighlightColor();
166                TransferAction action = TransferAction.PLAYER_BUY;
167                if (transferHandler != null && stackSource == transferHandler.getManifestOne()) {
168                        action = TransferAction.PLAYER_SELL;
169                }
170                
171                
172                if (action == TransferAction.PLAYER_SELL && stack.getSpecialItemSpecIfSpecial() != null) {
173                        SpecialItemSpecAPI spec = stack.getSpecialItemSpecIfSpecial();
174                        if (spec.hasTag(Tags.MISSION_ITEM)) {
175                                text = "Can not remove item";
176                                highlight = text;
177                                highlights = new Highlights();
178                                highlights.append(text, Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor());
179                                
180                                ItemCostLabelData data = new ItemCostLabelData();
181                                data.text = text;// + ".";
182                                data.highlights = highlights;
183                                
184                                return data;
185                        }
186                }
187                
188                
189                
190                if (transferHandler != null && transferHandler.getSubmarketTradedWith() != null &&
191                                transferHandler.getSubmarketTradedWith().isIllegalOnSubmarket(stack, action)) {
192                        highlightColor = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
193                        //text = "Illegal to trade on the " + transferHandler.getSubmarketTradedWith().getNameOneLine() + " here";
194                        text = transferHandler.getSubmarketTradedWith().getPlugin().getIllegalTransferText(stack, action);
195                        highlight = text;
196                        highlights = transferHandler.getSubmarketTradedWith().getPlugin().getIllegalTransferTextHighlights(stack, TransferAction.PLAYER_BUY);
197                } else {
198                        if (stackSource != null && transferHandler != null && !transferHandler.isNoCost()) {
199                                if (stackSource == transferHandler.getManifestOne()) {
200                                        int cost = (int)transferHandler.computeCurrentSingleItemSellCost(stack);
201                                        //text = "Sells for: " + Misc.getWithDGS(cost) + " credits per unit";
202                                        text = "Sells for: " + Misc.getDGSCredits(cost) + " per unit.";
203                                        highlight = "" + Misc.getDGSCredits(cost);
204                                } else {
205                                        int cost = (int)transferHandler.computeCurrentSingleItemBuyCost(stack);
206                                        //text = "Price: " + Misc.getWithDGS(cost) + " credits per unit";
207                                        text = "Price: " + Misc.getDGSCredits(cost) + " per unit.";
208                                        highlight = "" + Misc.getDGSCredits(cost);
209                                }
210                        } else {
211                                int cost = (int) stack.getBaseValuePerUnit();
212                                //float mult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("nonEconItemSellPriceMult");
213                                //cost *= mult;
214                                //text = "Base value: " + Misc.getWithDGS(cost) + " credits per unit";
215                                text = "Base value: " + Misc.getDGSCredits(cost) + " per unit.";
216                                highlight = "" + Misc.getDGSCredits(cost);
217                        }
218                }
219                
220                if (highlights == null) {
221                        highlights = new Highlights();
222                        highlights.setText(highlight);
223                        highlights.setColors(highlightColor);
224                }
225                
226                ItemCostLabelData data = new ItemCostLabelData();
227                data.text = text;// + ".";
228                data.highlights = highlights;
229                
230                return data;
231        }

246        protected void addShipList(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, String title, List<String> hulls, int max, float opad) {
247                addBlueprintList(tooltip, title, hulls, max, opad, new BlueprintLister(){
248                        public boolean isKnown(String id) {
249                                if (Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) return false;
250                                return Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().knowsShip(id);
251                        }
252                        public String getNoun(int num) {
253                                if (num == 1) return "hull";
254                                return "hulls";
255                        }
256                        public String getName(String id) {
257                                ShipHullSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getHullSpec(id);
258                                return spec.getNameWithDesignationWithDashClass();
259                        }
260                });
261        }

296        
297        protected void addBlueprintList(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, String title, List<String> ids, int max, float opad,
298                                BlueprintLister lister) {
299                
300                Color b = Misc.getButtonTextColor();
301                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
302                
303                if (Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) {
304                        tooltip.setParaSmallInsignia();
305                }
306                tooltip.addPara(title, opad);
307                if (Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) {
308                        tooltip.setParaFontDefault();
309                }
310                
311                String tab = "        ";
312                float small = 5f;
313                float pad = small;
314                
315                int left = ids.size();
316                
317                List<String> copy = new ArrayList<String>();
318                for (String id : ids) {
319                        if (!lister.isKnown(id)) copy.add(id);
320                }
321                for (String id : ids) {
322                        if (lister.isKnown(id)) copy.add(id);
323                }
324                
325                ids = copy;
326                for (String id : ids) {
327                        boolean known = lister.isKnown(id);
328                        
329                        if (known) {
330                                tooltip.addPara(tab + lister.getName(id) + " (known)", g, pad);
331                        } else {
332                                tooltip.addPara(tab + lister.getName(id), b, pad);
333                        }
334                        left--;
335                        pad = 3f;
336                        if (ids.size() - left >= max - 1) break;
337                }
338                if (ids.isEmpty()) {
339                        tooltip.addPara(tab + "None", pad);
340                }
341                if (left > 0) {
342                        String noun = lister.getNoun(left);
343                        tooltip.addPara(tab + "... and %s other " + noun + "", pad, Misc.getHighlightColor(), "" + left);
344                }
345        }
